Robinhood's Customer Experience team is committed to providing world-class service to our internal and external customers. The Resolutions Desk supports our customer experience associates by providing real-time education, resolving escalated situations, and acting as a resource when exceptions are needed.

As a CX Associate, Resolutions Desk, you'll be the first line of live support for our CX agents, helping them navigate customer questions across chat, email, and phone. You'll follow documented policies and playbooks to give agents fast, accurate answers, and escalations are part of the role from day one. As you build experience, you'll take on a growing share of escalation work and more complex cases over time. This is an unlicensed role.

This role is based in our Denver, CO and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

What you'll do

  • Serve as a real-time point of contact for CX agents across chat, email, and phone, answering questions according to well-defined policies, procedures, and escalation playbooks
  • Handle escalations as part of your regular workload from day one, resolving straightforward cases and building fluency for more complex ones over time
  • Apply a teaching-vs-telling approach so agents walk away better equipped to handle similar questions independently next time
  • Recognize when a situation calls for a supervisor and route it promptly
  • Issue goodwill credits and refunds within your authorized limits, escalating anything beyond that to your manager
  • Log and track your interactions accurately to support clear case history and smooth handoffs
  • Flag recurring agent questions or process gaps to your manager to help surface patterns worth addressing

What you bring

  • Experience in a customer-facing role, with a track record of strong performance — this is an entry point onto the Resolutions Desk, so prior escalation experience isn't required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly to both agents and customers
  • Comfortable applying documented policies and procedures on live escalations, with the judgment to know when to bring in a supervisor
  • Ability to quickly defuse anxiety and de-escalate tense situations through empathetic, confident communication
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when following playbooks and logging case information
  • High empathy paired with a teach-vs-tell communication style

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Radar ML team builds the fraud detection models that protect Stripe's $1.9 trillion payment network from fraud. The team owns 10 real-time deep learning models that must constantly evolve to stay ahead of fraudsters. Each ML improvement translates directly into dollar impact for Stripe and its users.

The team's models also power the Radar product suite that tens of thousands of businesses use to screen payments and manage fraud. Radar is growing fast, and the team is actively building new products to protect against AI token theft, free trial abuse, and scripted attacks.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will own ML work across the full lifecycle: researching new fraud patterns, building and deploying models, and sharing results directly with top Stripe customers. You will have opportunities to optimize Stripe’s most intensive ML models, and opportunities to ship 0-to-1 products from scratch. 

Responsibilities

  • Build, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models that detect fraud across Stripe’s global payments network
  • Research emerging fraud patterns like token theft and develop ML solutions to address them
  • Apply advances in deep learning to improve model quality and detection rates at scale
  • Co-build new fraud and abuse products directly with top users

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years of experience training, evaluating, and deploying ML models in a production environment
  • Proficiency in Python and common data and ML frameworks like SQL, Spark, and PyTorch
  • Strong knowledge of production ML systems; and data analysis, statistics, and experiment design fundamentals
  • Active interest in the latest ML developments, and how they can be leveraged to solve business problems

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong software engineering skills and ability to design ML solutions through entire product stack
  • Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML infrastructure at scale
  • Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, or a closely related domain

A quick run-down of the job

We're looking for a Data Product Lead to own the direction and output of LI.FI's Data team. This is partially a hands-on role with a clear focus on analytics and product thinking. You'll spend a significant portion of your time on the data yourself: deep-dive analyses, dashboards, business cases, and sharing insights that shape how we make decisions across the company. The rest of your time goes to product thinking, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and leading the team.

You'll report to our CTO and line manage the Data team, partnering closely with our Data Tech Lead who owns the technical and infrastructure side. Think of it as the PM-and-tech-lead model: you own the what and why, your tech lead partner owns the how. Together you set the roadmap and priorities for the team.

Please note: This role is remote within the EMEA region. Your application will not be considered otherwise.

What you'll do

  • Own the Data team's priorities, intake, and triage; run team rituals including planning, reviews, and workshops

  • Do hands-on analytics work: deep-dives, dashboards, business cases, and recommendations that change decisions, including data inputs for the weekly report and Monthly Business Review

  • Partner with Product Managers to embed tracking and success metrics into PRDs, and align the data roadmap with product roadmaps

  • Translate business questions from stakeholders into clear specs, metric definitions, and acceptance criteria the team can deliver

  • Act as the quality gate on analyses, dashboards, and datasets before they reach internal or external stakeholders

  • Coach and develop the Data team, levelling up team members on problem framing, communication, and stakeholder management

  • Partner with the Data Tech Lead to co-own the roadmap, making sure infrastructure work serves real business needs

What makes a good candidate

  • 6+ years in data analytics, analytics engineering, or data product work, with experience leading people or setting priorities for a small team

  • Expert SQL: you can pull, validate, and challenge data independently, without relying on engineers

  • Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools (Omni, Superset, or similar)

  • Strong business and product mindset: you use data to find revenue, pricing, or growth opportunities, not just to answer questions

  • Enough technical depth to be a real partner to data engineers; comfortable discussing warehouse design, pipelines, data models, and trade-offs

  • Proven stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across product, engineering, finance, BD, and C-suite

  • Strong data storytelling: you adapt the message to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Crypto/DeFi domain experience: ideally in a data role at a crypto company, or demonstrable deep understanding of the space (cross-chain, DEX aggregation, bridges, or wallets)

  • ML modelling experience (forecasting, classification, anomaly detection)

  • On-chain data and tooling (e.g. Dune Analytics)

We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine — leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.

In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You'll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. You'll also be a practitioner and champion of AI-powered tools — using them to automate workflows, accelerate insight generation, and elevate the sophistication of our marketing measurement at scale.

You'll use data to continuously improve reporting efficiency, forecast accuracy, and budget allocation decisions, helping ensure our marketing analytics engine drives measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own analytics and end-to-end measurement across all growth marketing functions, ensuring consistent and actionable reporting from spend to revenue.
  • Lead the visualization and reporting infrastructure across growth marketing, translating complex data into clear, compelling dashboards and narratives for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Lead pipeline attribution, ROI, CAC, LTV, and Ad spend distribution analyses to inform investment decisions, and partner with Growth Marketing, Finance, and RevOps on spend pacing and forecasting.
  • Evolve attribution modeling and performance measurement frameworks, using AI and machine learning to improve accuracy and scalability.
  • Apply AI-powered tools and predictive modeling to surface proactive insights, identify trends, and support faster, more confident decision-making across the marketing team.
  • Empower experimentation programs with thorough data-driven insights, including A/B testing and lift analyses.
  • Partner with the RevOps, Business Intelligence and Marketing Operations teams to use Salesforce, Tableau, MCI and other platforms, to build reporting that connect spend to pipeline and revenue.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and analytics workflows using AI to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Guided by empirical evidence and Stripe’s Fraud Taxonomy 3.0 (FT3) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into precise technical control requirements, such as API rate limits, step-up challenges, parameter validation, and pre-debit holds.

About Open Standard

Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.

Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.

Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

The role

As the Head of Liquidity and Capital Markets, you will own the liquidity strategy and execution for Open USD. Your mission: build deep markets on all relevant venues, on and off-chain, ensure listings wherever our partners trade, and secure acceptance as collateral at major protocols. Your work will be central to empowering our 200+ partners to move in and out at scale, fostering close partnerships with market makers, exchanges, financial institutions, and chains such as Tempo, Ethereum, Base, and Solana.

This is a rare opportunity to build the liquidity function from the ground up, with the budget, mandate, and team leadership needed as Open USD scales across new venues and chains.

What you’ll do

  • Own the liquidity capital plan across every chain and venue

  • Select and manage market makers and liquidity providers: negotiate loans, incentives, and exposures in partnership with Finance and Legal

  • Negotiate deals with chains, foundations, and protocols to list, pool, and accept Open USD as collateral

  • Manage exchange listings end-to-end, including due diligence and market making commitments

  • Build relationships with key custodians, oracles, bridges, and on/off ramps

  • Design growth programs ensuring spend results in lasting adoption and usage

  • Lead analytics: map partner demand, track depth and volume, monitor incentive ROI, and manage consultants and data vendors

  • Sequence launches and run the go/no-go process in partnership with the CEO

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 5+ years of experience at the intersection of DeFi and business development – preferably at a protocol, stablecoin issuer, exchange, chain, market maker, or crypto-native fintech

  • Possess detailed knowledge of onchain market structure: lending market risk parameters, collateral onboarding, AMM pool design, vault and curator models, incentive mechanisms, and how depth forms in a new pair

  • Understand the issuer’s perspective: mint/redemption flows and depth management under stress

  • Have strong relationships with protocol teams, market makers, and DeFi businesses

  • Have structured incentive programs and market maker arrangements that resulted in durable liquidity, and can illustrate before-and-after outcomes

Strong candidates may also have

  • Sourced and funded liquidity for a new asset and defended the plan to a board

  • Deep knowledge of market maker commercial structures and the ability to distinguish between real and artificial volume/depth

  • Sufficient quantitative fluency to independently model incentive returns and market maker economics

Logistics

  • Location: San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in-office and remote days

Come work with us

Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.
